hero.title: Your school, running itself.
hero.subtitle: Fees that balance to the rupee, results parents can trust, attendance and messages that reach every family — in English and Urdu.

marketing.footer: Built for schools in Pakistan. No ads. No trackers.

landing.heroNote: No ads. No trackers. Urdu and English from the first screen.
landing.campusLabel: A small 3D school campus rising out of the ground, with a school bus driving around it
landing.featuresSub: Everything a school office does every day — in one place, with a clear record of who did what.
landing.offlineBody: Teachers can mark attendance with no signal. Registers wait safely on the phone and are sent when the connection returns.

s1.b: Add your classes, fee heads and students. Brothers and sisters are linked automatically by the parent's phone number.

s2.b: Issue monthly vouchers, take payments, mark attendance and enter marks. Every action is recorded and nothing is edited behind your back.

s3.b: Fee challans, attendance and report cards — in the parent's own language, on their phone.

apps.sub: One sign-in. The right tools for each person.
apps.parentBody: See each child's attendance, fee vouchers with the number to pay, and published report cards.
apps.teacherBody: Mark the register in seconds, even with no signal. It is sent automatically when you are back online.
apps.officeBody: Fees, admissions, exams, payroll, approvals and reports — on any computer or phone browser.

appsPage.installSub: The web app installs like an app — own icon, full screen, and a friendly page when you are offline. No store needed.

android.a3: Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

appsPage.storeTitle: Store apps are on the way
appsPage.storeBody: The parent and teacher apps for Android and iPhone are built and being tested with schools. They will appear in the stores when testing is done. Want to be among the first? Book a demo.

fees.title: Fee collection
fees.body: Monthly vouchers, a printable challan, cash and bank payments, instalment plans, promises to pay and gentle reminders.

ledger.title: Books that always balance
ledger.body: Every rupee that moves is recorded in a double-entry ledger in the same moment. Corrections are reversals, never edits.

results.title: Exams and report cards
results.body: Teachers enter marks for their own classes, a coordinator moderates, and results are frozen when published.

attendance.title: Attendance and parent messages
attendance.body: Mark a class in seconds. Parents are told about an absence in their own language, within the hours they choose.

urdu.title: Urdu and English
urdu.body: Every screen and message exists in both languages, and right-to-left is first class, not an afterthought.

saferoute.title: SafeRoute
saferoute.body: Live school-bus tracking with the driver's app. Anything involving a child's own phone needs the family's recorded consent first.

compass.title: Learning Compass
compass.body: A current, human-reviewed picture of how each child learns best. Never a label, never a diagnosis.

trust.title: Our promises
trust.noAds: No advertising and no third-party trackers in school portals or apps.
trust.consent: No child is tracked without explicit, recorded consent that a parent can withdraw.
trust.isolation: Each school's data is separated inside the database itself, not only in the app.
trust.noLabels: We never label a child. Notes are current, reviewed by a person, and never a diagnosis.

privacy.title: Privacy and children
privacy.intro: These are the rules the product is built to follow.
privacy.legal: This page describes how the product behaves. It is not a legal privacy policy.

isolation.q: Can another school see our data?
isolation.a: No. Every table is locked to the school that owns it by the database itself. A bug in the app cannot open it.

consent.q: Is a child ever tracked without asking?
consent.a: No. Location features need a parent's explicit, recorded consent, and consent can be withdrawn at any time.

noAds.a: No advertising or third-party tracking scripts in school portals or apps.

noLabels.a: No. Learning notes are current, written or reviewed by a person, and are never a diagnosis.

humans.a: Automation can suggest. A permitted person approves. Money, results and payroll changes always have a person behind them.

access.q: Who at the vendor can look at our school?
access.a: Only with a written reason and a ticket, only if your school allows it, for 30 minutes, and your owner can see every session. Money, location and counsellor records are never reachable.
